RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between the Landlord and the Tenant on 1st August 2026.

1. PREMISES AND TERM: The Landlord lets to the Tenant the residential flat at 12 Ashoka Gardens for a term of eleven (11) months commencing 1st August 2026. The Tenant may renew for a further like term on the same conditions by giving thirty (30) days' notice before expiry.

2. RENT: The Tenant shall pay rent of Rs. 22,000 per month, payable by the 7th day of each month. No interest or penalty shall apply to a payment received within seven days of the due date.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT: The Tenant has paid a refundable deposit of Rs. 44,000, equal to two months' rent. The Landlord shall refund the deposit within fifteen (15) days of the Tenant vacating, less only the documented cost of repairing damage beyond normal wear and tear, supported by receipts furnished to the Tenant.

4. NOTICE TO VACATE: Either party may end this Agreement by giving the other sixty (60) days' written notice. Neither party shall owe the other any sum by reason only of such termination.

5. REPAIRS: The Landlord shall carry out and pay for all structural repairs, plumbing, electrical and waterproofing work. The Tenant shall carry out minor day-to-day maintenance and shall promptly inform the Landlord of any defect requiring attention.

6. ENTRY: The Landlord may enter the premises for inspection or repair upon giving the Tenant at least twenty-four (24) hours' prior notice, at a time convenient to the Tenant, save in an emergency.

7. ESCALATION: On renewal, the rent may be increased by not more than five per cent (5%) over the rent then payable.

8. QUIET ENJOYMENT: The Landlord covenants that the Tenant shall peaceably hold and enjoy the premises during the term without interruption by the Landlord.

9. UTILITIES: The Tenant shall pay for electricity, water and gas consumed, as per the meters installed. Property tax and society maintenance charges shall be borne by the Landlord.

10. COSTS: The cost of stamp duty and registration of this Agreement shall be shared equally between the parties.

11. DISPUTES: Any dispute shall be referred to a sole arbitrator appointed by mutual consent of both parties. Failing agreement, the parties may pursue such remedies as are available to them.

12. NOTICES: Notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered to the addresses stated above.
